title: La roba (1)
author: Giovanni Verga
note: Sicily, in the plains around Catania, in the 1800s: Mazzarò, once a barefoot farmhand, now owns almost everything you can see, and "la roba", his property, is his whole life. The story uses the passato remoto: when you hear "disse" or "fu", think "said", "was". Verga writes like Sicilian peasants talk, with old coins like the "tarì" and the "baiocco", and the odd Sicilian word.

segments.fr: Il viandante che andava lungo il Biviere di Lentini,
segments.en: The traveller who went along the Lake of Lentini,

segments.fr: steso là come un pezzo di mare morto,
segments.en: stretched out there like a piece of dead sea,

segments.fr: e le stoppie riarse della Piana di Catania,
segments.en: and the scorched stubble fields of the Plain of Catania,

segments.fr: e gli aranci sempre verdi di Francofonte,
segments.en: and the evergreen orange trees of Francofonte,

segments.fr: e i sugheri grigi di Resecone,
segments.en: and the grey cork oaks of Resecone,

segments.fr: e i pascoli deserti di Passaneto e di Passanitello,
segments.en: and the empty pastures of Passaneto and Passanitello,

segments.fr: se domandava, per ingannare la noia della lunga strada polverosa,
segments.en: if he asked, to cheat the boredom of the long dusty road,

segments.fr: sotto il cielo fosco dal caldo,
segments.en: under the sky hazy with heat,

segments.fr: nell'ora in cui i campanelli della lettiga
segments.en: at the hour when the bells of the mule litter

glosses.en: mule litter, a carriage carried by mules

segments.fr: suonano tristamente nell'immensa campagna,
segments.en: ring sadly in the immense countryside,

segments.fr: e i muli lasciano ciondolare il capo e la coda,
segments.en: and the mules let their heads and tails droop,

segments.fr: e il lettighiere canta la sua canzone malinconica
segments.en: and the litter driver sings his melancholy song

segments.fr: per non lasciarsi vincere dal sonno della malaria:
segments.en: so as not to be overcome by the sleepiness of malaria:

segments.fr: «Qui di chi è?» sentiva rispondersi: «Di Mazzarò.»
segments.en: "Whose is this here?" he would hear the answer: "Mazzarò's."

segments.fr: E passando vicino a una fattoria grande quanto un paese,
segments.en: And passing near a farm estate as big as a village,

segments.fr: coi magazzini che sembrano chiese,
segments.en: with storehouses that look like churches,

segments.fr: e le galline a stormi accoccolate all'ombra del pozzo,
segments.en: and hens in flocks crouching in the shade of the well,

segments.fr: e le donne che si mettevano la mano sugli occhi
segments.en: and the women who put a hand over their eyes

segments.fr: per vedere chi passava: «E qui?» «Di Mazzarò.»
segments.en: to see who was passing: "And here?" "Mazzarò's."

segments.fr: E cammina e cammina,
segments.en: And on and on you walked,

segments.fr: mentre la malaria vi pesava sugli occhi,
segments.en: while the malaria weighed on your eyes,

segments.fr: e vi scuoteva all'improvviso l'abbaiare di un cane,
segments.en: and the barking of a dog suddenly startled you,

segments.fr: passando per una vigna che non finiva più,
segments.en: passing through a vineyard that never ended,

segments.fr: e si allargava sul colle e sul piano, immobile,
segments.en: and spread over hill and plain, motionless,

segments.fr: come gli pesasse addosso la polvere,
segments.en: as if the dust lay heavy on it,

segments.fr: e il guardiano sdraiato bocconi sullo schioppo, accanto al vallone,
segments.en: and the watchman lying face down on his shotgun, beside the ravine,

segments.fr: levava il capo sonnacchioso,
segments.en: raised his sleepy head,

segments.fr: e apriva un occhio per vedere chi fosse: «Di Mazzarò.»
segments.en: and opened one eye to see who it was: "Mazzarò's."

segments.fr: Poi veniva un uliveto folto come un bosco,
segments.en: Then came an olive grove as thick as a forest,

segments.fr: dove l'erba non spuntava mai,
segments.en: where the grass never sprouted,

segments.fr: e la raccolta durava fino a marzo.
segments.en: and the harvest lasted until March.

segments.fr: Erano gli ulivi di Mazzarò.
segments.en: They were Mazzarò's olive trees.

segments.fr: E verso sera, allorchè il sole tramontava rosso come il fuoco,
segments.en: And towards evening, when the sun set as red as fire,

segments.fr: e la campagna si velava di tristezza,
segments.en: and the countryside was veiled in sadness,

segments.fr: si incontravano le lunghe file degli aratri di Mazzarò
segments.en: you met the long lines of Mazzarò's ploughs

segments.fr: che tornavano adagio adagio dal maggese,
segments.en: coming back very slowly from the fallow fields,

segments.fr: e i buoi che passavano il guado lentamente,
segments.en: and the oxen slowly crossing the ford,

segments.fr: col muso nell'acqua scura;
segments.en: with their muzzles in the dark water;

segments.fr: e si vedevano nei pascoli lontani della Canziria,
segments.en: and you saw in the distant pastures of the Canziria,

segments.fr: sulla pendice brulla,
segments.en: on the bare hillside,

segments.fr: le immense macchie biancastre delle mandre di Mazzarò;
segments.en: the huge whitish patches of Mazzarò's herds;

segments.fr: e si udiva il fischio del pastore echeggiare nelle gole,
segments.en: and you heard the shepherd's whistle echoing in the gorges,

segments.fr: e il campanaccio che risuonava ora sì ed ora no,
segments.en: and the cowbell ringing now and then,

segments.fr: e il canto solitario perduto nella valle.
segments.en: and the lonely song lost in the valley.

segments.fr: «Tutta roba di Mazzarò.»
segments.en: "All Mazzarò's property."

segments.fr: Pareva che fosse di Mazzarò perfino il sole che tramontava,
segments.en: It seemed that even the setting sun belonged to Mazzarò,

segments.fr: e le cicale che ronzavano,
segments.en: and the cicadas buzzing,

segments.fr: e gli uccelli che andavano a rannicchiarsi col volo breve dietro le zolle,
segments.en: and the birds that flew in short hops to huddle behind the clods,

segments.fr: e il sibilo dell'assiolo nel bosco.
segments.en: and the hoot of the scops owl in the wood.

segments.fr: Pareva che Mazzarò fosse disteso tutto grande
segments.en: It seemed that Mazzarò lay stretched out, as big

segments.fr: per quanto era grande la terra,
segments.en: as the land was big,

segments.fr: e che gli si camminasse sulla pancia.
segments.en: and that you were walking on his belly.

segments.fr: «Invece egli era un omiciattolo», diceva il lettighiere,
segments.en: "Instead he was a little runt of a man," said the litter driver,

segments.fr: «che non gli avreste dato un baiocco, a vederlo;
segments.en: "you wouldn't have given a penny for him, to look at him;

segments.fr: e di grasso non aveva altro che la pancia,
segments.en: and the only fat thing on him was his belly,

segments.fr: e non si sapeva come facesse a riempirla,
segments.en: and nobody knew how he managed to fill it,

segments.fr: perchè non mangiava altro che due soldi di pane;
segments.en: because he ate nothing but two pennies' worth of bread;

segments.fr: e sì ch'era ricco come un maiale;
segments.en: and yet he was as rich as a pig;

segments.fr: ma aveva la testa ch'era un brillante, quell'uomo.»
segments.en: but he had a head like a diamond, that man."

segments.fr: Infatti, colla testa come un brillante,
segments.en: In fact, with his head like a diamond,

segments.fr: aveva accumulato tutta quella roba,
segments.en: he had piled up all that property,

segments.fr: dove prima veniva da mattina a sera
segments.en: where once he used to come from morning to night

segments.fr: a zappare, a potare, a mietere;
segments.en: to hoe, to prune, to reap;

segments.fr: col sole, coll'acqua, col vento;
segments.en: in sun, in rain, in wind;

segments.fr: senza scarpe ai piedi, e senza uno straccio di cappotto;
segments.en: with no shoes on his feet, and without a rag of a coat;

segments.fr: che tutti si rammentavano di avergli dato dei calci nel di dietro,
segments.en: so that they all remembered having kicked him in the backside,

segments.fr: quelli che ora gli davano dell'eccellenza,
segments.en: those who now called him "Your Excellency",

segments.fr: e gli parlavano col berretto in mano.
segments.en: and spoke to him with their caps in their hands.

segments.fr: Nè per questo egli era montato in superbia,
segments.en: Yet he hadn't become proud because of it,

segments.fr: adesso che tutte le eccellenze del paese erano suoi debitori;
segments.en: now that all the excellencies of the town were in his debt;

segments.fr: e diceva che eccellenza vuol dire povero diavolo e cattivo pagatore;
segments.en: and he said that excellency means poor devil and bad payer;

segments.fr: ma egli portava ancora il berretto,
segments.en: but he still wore the peasant's cap,

segments.fr: soltanto lo portava di seta nera,
segments.en: only he wore it in black silk,

segments.fr: era la sua sola grandezza,
segments.en: that was his only show of grandeur,

segments.fr: e da ultimo era anche arrivato a mettere il cappello di feltro,
segments.en: and lately he had even taken to wearing a felt hat,

segments.fr: perchè costava meno del berretto di seta.
segments.en: because it cost less than the silk cap.

segments.fr: Della roba ne possedeva fin dove arrivava la vista,
segments.en: He owned property as far as the eye could see,

segments.fr: ed egli aveva la vista lunga,
segments.en: and he had long sight,

segments.fr: dappertutto, a destra e a sinistra, davanti e di dietro,
segments.en: everywhere, to the right and to the left, in front and behind,

segments.fr: nel monte e nella pianura.
segments.en: on the mountain and on the plain.

segments.fr: Più di cinquemila bocche,
segments.en: More than five thousand mouths,

segments.fr: senza contare gli uccelli del cielo e gli animali della terra,
segments.en: not counting the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth,

segments.fr: che mangiavano sulla sua terra,
segments.en: that ate on his land,

segments.fr: e senza contare la sua bocca la quale mangiava meno di tutte,
segments.en: and not counting his own mouth, which ate less than all of them,

segments.fr: e si contentava di due soldi di pane e un pezzo di formaggio,
segments.en: and was happy with two pennies' worth of bread and a piece of cheese,

segments.fr: ingozzato in fretta e in furia, all'impiedi,
segments.en: gulped down in a great rush, standing up,

segments.fr: in un cantuccio del magazzino grande come una chiesa,
segments.en: in a corner of the storehouse as big as a church,

segments.fr: in mezzo alla polvere del grano, che non ci si vedeva,
segments.en: in the middle of the grain dust, so thick you couldn't see,

segments.fr: mentre i contadini scaricavano i sacchi,
segments.en: while the peasants unloaded the sacks,

segments.fr: o a ridosso di un pagliaio,
segments.en: or sheltered against a haystack,

segments.fr: quando il vento spazzava la campagna gelata, al tempo del seminare,
segments.en: when the wind swept the frozen countryside, at sowing time,

segments.fr: o colla testa dentro un corbello, nelle calde giornate della mèsse.
segments.en: or with his head inside a basket, on the hot days of the harvest.

segments.fr: Egli non beveva vino, non fumava, non usava tabacco,
segments.en: He didn't drink wine, he didn't smoke, he didn't take snuff,

segments.fr: e sì che del tabacco ne producevano i suoi orti lungo il fiume,
segments.en: even though his fields along the river grew tobacco,

segments.fr: colle foglie larghe ed alte come un fanciullo,
segments.en: with leaves as wide and tall as a child,

segments.fr: di quelle che si vendevano a novantacinque lire.
segments.en: the kind that sold for ninety-five lire.

segments.fr: Non aveva il vizio del giuoco, nè quello delle donne.
segments.en: He didn't have the vice of gambling, nor that of women.

segments.fr: Di donne non aveva mai avuto sulle spalle che sua madre,
segments.en: The only woman he'd ever had to support was his mother,

segments.fr: la quale gli era costata anche dodici tarì,
segments.en: who had even cost him twelve tarì,

segments.fr: quando aveva dovuto farla portare al camposanto.
segments.en: when he'd had to have her carried to the cemetery.

segments.fr: Era che ci aveva pensato e ripensato tanto
segments.en: It was that he had thought and thought so much

segments.fr: a quel che vuol dire la roba,
segments.en: about what property means,

segments.fr: quando andava senza scarpe a lavorare nella terra che adesso era sua,
segments.en: when he went barefoot to work on the land that was now his,

segments.fr: ed aveva provato quel che ci vuole a fare i tre tarì della giornata,
segments.en: and had learned what it takes to earn the three tarì of a day's wage,

segments.fr: nel mese di luglio, a star colla schiena curva quattordici ore,
segments.en: in the month of July, bent over for fourteen hours,

segments.fr: col soprastante a cavallo dietro,
segments.en: with the overseer on horseback behind you,

segments.fr: che vi piglia a nerbate se fate di rizzarvi un momento.
segments.en: who lashes you with a whip if you try to straighten up for a moment.

segments.fr: Per questo non aveva lasciato passare un minuto della sua vita
segments.en: That's why he hadn't let a single minute of his life go by

segments.fr: che non fosse stato impiegato a fare della roba;
segments.en: that wasn't spent making property;

segments.fr: e adesso i suoi aratri erano numerosi
segments.en: and now his ploughs were as many

segments.fr: come le lunghe file dei corvi che arrivavano in novembre;
segments.en: as the long lines of crows that arrived in November;

segments.fr: e altre file di muli, che non finivano più, portavano le sementi;
segments.en: and other lines of mules, that never ended, carried the seed;

segments.fr: le donne che stavano accoccolate nel fango, da ottobre a marzo,
segments.en: the women who crouched in the mud, from October to March,

segments.fr: per raccogliere le sue olive, non si potevano contare,
segments.en: to gather his olives, couldn't be counted,

segments.fr: come non si possono contare le gazze che vengono a rubarle;
segments.en: just as you can't count the magpies that come to steal them;

segments.fr: e al tempo della vendemmia
segments.en: and at grape-harvest time

segments.fr: accorrevano dei villaggi interi alle sue vigne,
segments.en: whole villages came running to his vineyards,

segments.fr: e fin dove sentivasi cantare, nella campagna,
segments.en: and as far as you could hear singing, in the countryside,

segments.fr: era per la vendemmia di Mazzarò.
segments.en: it was for Mazzarò's grape harvest.

segments.fr: Alla mèsse poi i mietitori di Mazzarò
segments.en: And at harvest time Mazzarò's reapers

segments.fr: sembravano un esercito di soldati,
segments.en: looked like an army of soldiers,

segments.fr: che per mantenere tutta quella gente,
segments.en: so that to feed all those people,

segments.fr: col biscotto alla mattina e il pane e l'arancia amara a colazione,
segments.en: with hard biscuit in the morning and bread and bitter orange at lunch,

segments.fr: e la merenda, e le lasagne alla sera,
segments.en: and the afternoon snack, and lasagne in the evening,

segments.fr: ci volevano dei denari a manate,
segments.en: it took money by the handful,

segments.fr: e le lasagne si scodellavano nelle madie larghe come tinozze.
segments.en: and the lasagne were dished out in kneading troughs as wide as washtubs.

segments.fr: Perciò adesso, quando andava a cavallo dietro la fila dei suoi mietitori,
segments.en: So now, when he rode behind the line of his reapers,

segments.fr: col nerbo in mano, non ne perdeva d'occhio uno solo,
segments.en: whip in hand, he never took his eyes off a single one,

segments.fr: e badava a ripetere: «Curviamoci, ragazzi!»
segments.en: and he kept repeating: "Let's bend down, boys!"

segments.fr: Egli era tutto l'anno colle mani in tasca a spendere,
segments.en: All year long he had his hands in his pockets, paying out,

segments.fr: e per la sola fondiaria il re si pigliava tanto
segments.en: and for the land tax alone the king took so much

segments.fr: che a Mazzarò gli veniva la febbre, ogni volta.
segments.en: that Mazzarò got a fever, every time.
